en.d: A rail is a themed row of content — modules, events, exams, even other rails — shown together under one title. Manage them under Club Settings → Content Rails.
Give the rail a clear title and description — coaches won't see the description, it's just for your reference. An image is optional.
Click "Create". The rail starts as Unpublished — you'll add content and publish it next.
On the "Activities" tab, click "Add Activity" and choose what to add: a Module, an Event, an Exam — or even another Rail, nested inside this one.

Search by name, then tick everything you want in this rail — you can select several at once. Don't have the content yet? Each picker has its own "Create" shortcut, so you can make it without leaving this screen.
Click "Add" to bring the selected items into the rail.

en.t: Everything now lives on the rail
en.d: Each item shows its type and status. Drag the handle on the left to reorder them, or click "Add Activity" again any time to add more.
Back on the "Details" tab, change Status to "Published", then click "Update" to save.

en.doneD: The rail is published with its content inside. Whether it appears on the coach homepage from here depends on your Page Builder setup — if it doesn't show up automatically, check with your Coaches' Voice contact about adding it to your homepage layout.
en.lead: For club admins. Rails are how content actually reaches coaches — group modules, events and exams together, then publish.
